bar.name: Quick Fate
bar.text: Your first Evil Eye each battle adds 1 extra Omen.

bar.name: Grim Herald
bar.text: The first Doom you cause each battle deals +20% damage.

bar.name: Long Rot
bar.text: Wither you apply lasts 1 turn longer.

bar.name: Carrion Feast
bar.text: Wither on an enemy below 30% HP deals +20% damage.

bar.name: Hour of Ruin
bar.text: Once per battle, when Doom strikes, Doom Mark's cooldown drops by 2.

0.f1.name: Fresh Host
0.f1.text: Doom on a host of passed Omens deals +3% damage per rank.

0.f2.name: Grim Arithmetic
0.f2.text: Doom +4% damage per rank against targets below 50% HP.

0.n0.name: Fate Sealed
0.n0.text: An enemy that survives Doom keeps 1 Omen, so the next Doom comes sooner.

0.r.name: Bitter Interest
0.r.text: Doom heals you for 4% of its damage per rank.

0.eb.name: Doom Leaks
0.eb.text: When Doom kills, 1 Omen passes to the nearest enemy anyway.

0.ma.name: Ruinous Crit
0.ma.text: A critical Doom deals x2 damage instead of x1.5.

0.fa.name: Overcharged Doom
0.fa.text: Doom deals +30% damage, but you take 10% of that damage yourself.

0.fb.name: Final Toll
0.fb.text: Doom deals +40% to targets below 30% HP, but -20% to targets above it.

0.mb.name: Toppling Ruin
0.mb.text: When Doom kills, your next turn comes 50% sooner.

0.v.name: Herald of Ruin
0.v.text: Ill Omen evolves: when a cursed enemy dies, the nearest enemy suffers a Doom sized by the dead foe's Omens.

1.f1.name: Prying Eye
1.f1.text: Evil Eye +4% power per rank against enemies with no Omens.

1.f2.name: Unblinking
1.f2.text: Evil Eye +2% critical chance per rank.

1.f3.name: Envy's Edge
1.f3.text: Evil Eye +4% power per rank against targets with 2 Omens.

1.n0.name: Opening Glare
1.n0.text: Evil Eye on a target with no Omens adds 2 Omens.

1.r.name: Rheumy Stare
1.r.text: Evil Eye +2% critical chance per rank against Withered targets.

1.ea.name: Glint of Malice
1.ea.text: Evil Eye +10% critical chance against targets with Omens.

1.eb.name: Fixed Stare
1.eb.text: Evil Eye +12% power if it hits the same target as your last skill.

1.ma.name: Fatal Glance
1.ma.text: A critical Evil Eye adds 3 Omens instead of 2, so it always brings Doom.

1.fa.name: Strained Eyes
1.fa.text: Evil Eye +15% critical chance, but its power drops by 15%.

1.fb.name: Burning Stare
1.fb.text: Evil Eye +25% power, but it costs 6 MP.

1.mb.name: Doom Gaze
1.mb.text: When Evil Eye brings Doom, that Doom deals +30% damage.

1.v.name: Eye of Ruin
1.v.text: Evil Eye evolves: it adds 2 Omens per hit (3 on a crit), but deals no direct damage.

2.f1.name: Plague Breath
2.f1.text: Withering Curse +1% power per rank for each enemy it hits.

2.f2.name: Fog of Ill Luck
2.f2.text: Withered enemies have -2% accuracy per rank.

2.f3.name: Leeching Rot
2.f3.text: Wither ticks heal you for 2% of their damage per rank.

2.n0.name: Herd Curse
2.n0.text: If Withering Curse hits 3 or more enemies, each gains 1 extra Omen.

2.r.name: Rot Contagion
2.r.text: Withering Curse has a 10% chance per rank to also curse an enemy just outside its area.

2.eb.name: Seeping Rot
2.eb.text: When Wither ends on an enemy, the enemies next to it are Withered for 2 turns.

2.ma.name: Plague Tide
2.ma.text: Withering Curse also adds 1 Omen to every enemy outside its area that has one.

2.fa.name: Thin Plague
2.fa.text: Withering Curse hits every enemy, but deals half damage and its Wither lasts 1 turn.

2.fb.name: Gnawing Rot
2.fb.text: Withering Curse's Wither deals +50%, but lasts 2 turns.

2.mb.name: Returning Curse
2.mb.text: When an enemy Withered by the Curse dies, Withering Curse's cooldown resets.

2.v.name: Plague Curse
2.v.text: Withering Curse evolves: its Wither is contagious: each tick also Withers an enemy next to the host for 2 turns.

3.f1.name: Clinging Jinx
3.f1.text: Jinxed has a 10% chance per rank not to end after the target's attack.

3.f2.name: Wobbly Aim
3.f2.text: Jinxed lowers accuracy by 2% more per rank (-20% → -30%).

3.f3.name: Hex Ward
3.f3.text: While any enemy is Jinxed, you take 3% less damage per rank.

3.n0.name: Double Jinx
3.n0.text: Jinxed lasts through the target's next 2 attacks.

3.r.name: Rumour Mill
3.r.text: Jinx has a 10% chance per rank to also Jinx an enemy next to the target.

3.eb.name: Backlash
3.eb.text: When a Jinxed enemy misses, it takes dark damage equal to 40% of your LUCK.

3.ma.name: Woeful Turn
3.ma.text: A Jinxed enemy that misses loses its next action.

3.fa.name: Spiteful Jinx
3.fa.text: Jinx also Silences for 1 turn, but its cooldown is 5.

3.fb.name: Feeble Jinx
3.fb.text: Jinxed lowers accuracy by 40%, but Jinx deals no damage.

3.mb.name: Turned Luck
3.mb.text: When a Jinxed enemy misses, the ally it aimed at gains Haste for 1 turn.

3.v.name: Turned Hand
3.v.text: Jinx evolves: the Jinxed target's next attack strikes one of its own allies instead.

4.u1.name: Leaping Mark
4.u1.text: If Doom Mark kills, its Doom leaps to the nearest enemy at 50%.

4.u2.name: Hungry Leap
4.u2.text: Doom Mark's leap deals 75% instead of 50%.

4.u3.name: Unending Mark
4.u3.text: Doom Mark's leap repeats after every kill.

4.r1.name: Gathering Mark
4.r1.text: Doom Mark first pulls 1 Omen from up to 2 other enemies onto the target.

4.r2.name: Overflowing Fate
4.r2.text: Each pulled Omen past 3 adds +20% to Doom Mark's Doom.

4.r3.name: Mark of Many
4.r3.text: Doom Mark pulls 1 Omen from every other enemy before it detonates.

4.d1.name: Sealing Mark
4.d1.text: Doom Mark Silences the target for 1 turn.

4.d3.name: Mark of Silence
4.d3.text: Doom Mark Silences every caster in the target's row for 1 turn.

4.l1.name: Dread Ward
4.l1.text: After Doom Mark, you are Shrouded for 1 turn.

4.l2.name: Cowed Foe
4.l2.text: An enemy that survives Doom Mark is Jinxed for 2 turns.

4.l3.name: Last Rite
4.l3.text: Once per battle, a killing blow on you leaves you at 1 HP and fires a free Doom Mark at the killer.
